title: Pipeline event log entry
description: One JSON object per line in output/events.jsonl. Emitted by StructuredEventLogger during scrape runs. Every entry has `ts` (ISO 8601 UTC) and `kind`; other fields vary by kind — see the oneOf branches. Nine kinds observed in the current corpus; a tenth (enrichment_challenge) is declared for a code path (enrichment.py:94) that emits it on press-summary WAF hits but has not fired in the current run. Strict shape enforcement uses `unevaluatedProperties: false` at the outer level, which in draft-2020-12 semantics rejects any field not declared by the outer schema OR by the matching oneOf branch — this is the correct pattern for a discriminated union and is equivalent to `additionalProperties: false` for non-union schemas.

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with microsecond precision (e.g. '2026-07-04T11:58:24.418111+00:00').

extra.description: Optional bag for per-kind auxiliary data. Contents vary: ip_echo carries {observed_ip}; enrichment_challenge carries {enrichment_kind}. Declared at the outer level so any branch may attach it without exhaustive per-branch listing.

oneOf.description: request_failed has two producer variants: (a) exception path in proxy_pool.py's httpx.RequestError handler — carries error_class + error_msg, no http_status; (b) HTTP-status path in _emit_request_event when response status is in _PROXY_FAILURE_STATUSES (403/429/5xx) — carries http_status, no error_class/error_msg. All three fields are optional here so both variants validate; the schema does not currently discriminate between them.

challenge_detected — WAF/interstitial captured mid-scrape. Emitted by scraper.py and html_recheck.py; both supply proxy_url via getattr(resp, 'hklii_proxy_url', None) which is stamped by proxy_pool.py:460 on every response the pool serves.

enrichment_challenge — WAF/interstitial captured during press-summary fetch (enrichment.py:94). Zero rows in the current corpus but the code path exists and its test asserts the kind is emitted. `extra.enrichment_kind` names which enrichment step (e.g. 'summary_en').
